entry.title: Python Tip: Quickly Comment or Uncomment Multiple Lines
entry.summary:
Tired of typing # on every line in Python? Most editors (VS Code, PyCharm, Jupyter) have a shortcut that makes this instant: Windows/Linux: Ctrl + / Mac: Cmd + / *How it works:
Highlight the lines you want to comment or uncomment.
Press the shortcut.
Done! Press again to remove the comments.
x = 10
Highlight and hit Ctrl + / → all lines get commented out in one go. Press again → they’re back! A tiny shortcut, but a huge time-saver when debugging or experimenting.
